workflow:
cc_Start Start a CC server. 1.0.0.0
IBM
5655-EKM UKO V2R1+ ccserver
&variables;
Check if server running Check whether the server is running already $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_CONSOLE} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_CONSOLE} Execute console API to check the server is running already 1 z/OS administration true
PUT /zosmf/restconsoles/consoles/defcn
{ "cmd" : "d a,${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}", "sol-key" : "NOT FOUND", "system" : "${_workflow-systemName}"
}
200 ["sol-key-detected"]
Checking zFS is mounted Check the zFS mount point and remount if not mounted $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_ZFS} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_ZFS}
"1" == "1" Should the step be executed based on the SERVER_REST_STATUS setting
Check to see whether this step should be skipped
Only execute it SERVER_REST_STATUS is not detected ${instance-SERVER_REST_STATUS} == "false" Skipped
Remount the zFS for the server if needed 1 CC Administration true
#set ( $d = "$") #set ($zfs = "${instance-SERVER_FILE_SYSTEM_HLQ}.${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}") if [ ! -d ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/PROVISION_OK ]; then # Query information about the main mountpoint df_out=${d}(df ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR})
echo "df_out set to ${d}df_out"
# Split to obtain the data set for the mount point dataset=${d}(echo ${d}df_out | sed -e 's/.*(//' | sed -e 's/).*//')
echo "dataset set to ${d}dataset"
# Using the data set restrict using grep in the mount -qv comment mount_info=${d}(mount -qv ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR} | grep ${d}dataset)
echo "mount_info set to ${d}mount_info"
# Look at the 5 byte to work out what to do next parent_mount=${d}(expr substr "${d}mount_info" 5 1)
echo "parent_mount set to ${d}parent_mount"
# Decide the automount value case ${d}parent_mount in "A") echo "Automount (yes)" mountvalue="yes" ;; "U") echo "Unmount (unmount)" mountvalue="unmount" ;; "-") echo "NoAutomount (no)" mountvalue="no" ;; esac
echo "mountvalue ${d}mountvalue"
echo "Running command: mount -t ZFS -a ${d}mountvalue -f ${zfs} ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}"
mount -t ZFS -a ${d}mountvalue -f ${zfs} ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} rc=${d}? if [ ${d}rc -gt 0 ]; then echo "Failed to mount the directory see STDERR with RC ${d}rc" exit ${d}rc fi else echo "No mount required"; fi
shell-JCL
Checking zFS output is mounted Check the zFS mount point and remount if not mounted $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_ZFS} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_ZFS}
"1" == "1" Should the step be executed based on the SERVER_REST_STATUS setting
Check to see whether this step should be skipped
Only execute it SERVER_REST_STATUS is not detected ${instance-SERVER_REST_STATUS} == "false" Skipped
Remount the zFS for the server if needed 1 CC Administration true
#set ( $d = "$") #set ($zfs = "${instance-SERVER_FILE_SYSTEM_HLQ}.${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}.OUTPUT") if [ ! -d ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/PROVISION_OK ]; then # Query information about the main mountpoint df_out=${d}(df ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR})
echo "df_out set to ${d}df_out"
# Split to obtain the data set for the mount point dataset=${d}(echo ${d}df_out | sed -e 's/.*(//' | sed -e 's/).*//')
echo "dataset set to ${d}dataset"
# Using the data set restrict using grep in the mount -qv comment mount_info=${d}(mount -qv ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR} | grep ${d}dataset)
echo "mount_info set to ${d}mount_info"
# Look at the 5 byte to work out what to do next parent_mount=${d}(expr substr "${d}mount_info" 5 1)
echo "parent_mount set to ${d}parent_mount"
# Decide the automount value case ${d}parent_mount in "A") echo "Automount (yes)" mountvalue="yes" ;; "U") echo "Unmount (unmount)" mountvalue="unmount" ;; "-") echo "NoAutomount (no)" mountvalue="no" ;; esac
echo "mountvalue ${d}mountvalue"
echo "Running command: mount -t ZFS -a ${d}mountvalue -f ${zfs} ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}"
mount -t ZFS -a ${d}mountvalue -f ${zfs} ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} rc=${d}? if [ ${d}rc -gt 0 ]; then echo "Failed to mount the directory see STDERR with RC ${d}rc" exit ${d}rc fi else echo "No mount required"; fi
shell-JCL
&step_start_server;
